pps.notes: This printer is enclosed but has no chamber heater, so it holds no set ambient temperature. QIDI ships the chamber-heated sibling's recipe for this material with the ambient term removed, which shows up as corner lift and weaker layer bonding that scales with part size and height. PPS softens around 180C, so an unheated chamber gives a much larger gradient than the recipe assumes. Well-dried small parts only. Glass-filled PPS is the exception - QIDI asks for no chamber heat on that grade even on the chamber-heated sibling, so it loses nothing here. Ventilation: the Q2C ships with NO air filter - it is an optional extra - and its enclosure fan runs at full for the whole print, so the chamber is actively vented into your room. Ventilate the space; do not rely on a filter that is not fitted.
